_comment: Seed for the LOCAL Supabase stack (supabase start). Deliberately small —
just enough to exercise everything built in Sept 2026: tool page ownership,
the tiered feed, the follow button and the login flow. Cloning 16k tools
Two users, because half of what needs testing (following, feed tiers, the
claim CTA as a non-owner) is invisible with only one account.
Run from frontend/ with the local credentials printed by `supabase start`:

users.bio: Growth marketer. Owns the Clay page for ownership testing.
Second account — follow this one to test the feed and follow button.

tools.name: Clay
tools.description: Clay helps Go-To-Market teams access unique data from 100+ sources and AI agents, enabling them to automate growth workflows. Grant yourself ownership of this one to test the four edit pencils.

tools.name: HubSpot
tools.description: All-in-one CRM and marketing platform covering marketing, sales, service and CMS.

tools.name: Lemlist
tools.description: Cold email outreach and automation with deliverability tooling built in.

tools.name: Apollo
tools.description: B2B database and sales engagement platform with contact and company data.

tools.name: Notion
tools.description: Connected workspace for notes, docs, wikis and lightweight project tracking.

tools.name: Brevo
tools.description: Affordable all-in-one marketing and CRM stack — email, SMS, WhatsApp and chat.

tools.name: Toolwithnologo
tools.description: Deliberately has no logo_url, so the ToolLogo initials fallback and the owner's 'Change logo' dialog can both be checked.

playbooks.author: bob
playbooks.title: Enrich inbound leads with Clay before they hit the CRM
playbooks.description: Turn a bare email address into a scored, routed lead.
body: Published by bob, about Clay. Follow bob to see this as a tier 1 feed item.
Follow Clay but not bob to see it as tier 2, badged 'tool you follow'.
Follow neither and it should not appear at all — that was the bug.

playbooks.author: bob
playbooks.title: Capture visitors in HubSpot and follow up with Lemlist
body: Push contacts into a Lemlist campaign.
Second post by bob, so the feed has more than one row to order.

playbooks.author: alice
playbooks.title: Apollo vs Clay for outbound data
playbooks.description: Which one to reach for, and when.
body: Written by alice. Signed in as alice this must NOT appear in her own feed —
a feed is what other people did.
Signed in as bob, following alice, it should appear as tier 1.
